name: OpenCode Usage
author: ardfard
description: Local OpenCode usage: per-model tokens, cost ranking, day sparkline, and OpenCode Go limit windows.

barWidget.description: Click: usage panel (limits + models by cost). Middle/right click: force refresh.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-run the local collector. Data comes from the local opencode.db, so short intervals are cheap.

schema.label: Usage window (days)
schema.description: How many days of history feed the model ranking, the cost total and the sparkline.

schema.label: Max model rows
schema.description: How many models to show individually; the rest are folded into an "other" row.
